title: Result
description: Four-gate evidence bundle summary .agent/runs/<TASK-ID>/result.json (spec Appendix B, F.9). The Merge Refinery requires a complete four-gate result before a candidate may reach MERGE_READY (spec F.9). Normative example: spec Appendix B (ACCOUNT-12).

commit.description: Commit hash of the candidate (Appendix B).

verifier.description: Verifier binding id that produced the functional gate, e.g. api-verifier-03 (Appendix B).

gateValue.description: Gate outcome (DESIGN.md §3, spec §10 four gates: Functional, Specification, Architectural, Evolutionary).
